cases.title: GPU black screen under 3D load after driver update
possibleCauses: thermal hotspot or poor cooler contact
resolutionSteps: Boot with the previous known-good driver using Safe Mode.
Reseat both PCIe power connectors and remove daisy-chain adapters.
Log GPU core and hotspot temperature while reproducing the load.
If the fault follows the card in another system, stop testing and request RMA.

cases.title: CPU reaches thermal limit and clocks down during compile
possibleCauses: fan curve or BIOS power limit
resolutionSteps: Confirm the cooler pump or fan reports a non-zero RPM.
Inspect mounting pressure and renew thermal compound.
Load BIOS defaults, then compare stock power limits before applying an overclock.

cases.title: System loops at POST after adding a memory kit
resolutionSteps: Power off, discharge, and reseat each DIMM.
Test one module in the board's recommended slot.
Clear CMOS and boot at JEDEC defaults before enabling a profile.
Check the board QVL and update firmware only from the vendor site.

cases.title: Embedded board does not power on after load step
symptoms: input current is lower than expected
resolutionSteps: Disconnect the load and measure resistance to ground on each rail.
Use a current-limited bench supply and inspect the switching node.
Do not bypass protection circuits until the schematic and safe limits are confirmed.
